test.//dependsOn: The default lane is now purely in-process: the live `mvn`/`javac`/`java` Javalin suite and the real child-process SIGTERM/pgrep hygiene suite moved to sibling *.e2e.ts files with cheap *.spec.ts stubs. It no longer spawns a JVM and no longer declares `apigen-java:package`; that resource prerequisite now lives ONLY on the `e2e` target. This target inherits the workspace targetDefaults.test dependsOn (["lint", "^build"]).
test.//inputs: Exclude *.e2e.ts so editing a resource-consuming suite never invalidates the default lane's cache — it never runs those files (its vitest `include` is `src/**/*.spec.ts`, see vite.config.ts). Mirrors the workspace targetDefaults.test inputs plus the negative pattern.

e2e.//: RESOURCE-CONSUMING lane. Deliberately NOT part of `affected` and NOT referenced by any target's dependsOn or by targetDefaults — it runs ONLY on an explicit `nx run apigen-plugin-java-javalin:e2e` (nx affected never selects it). It runs the sibling *.e2e.ts suites via vitest.e2e.config.ts. `dependsOn` is exactly the resource prerequisites those suites need: `build` (the plugin's own built artifact) and `apigen-java:package` (the real JVM pipeline the plugin drives).
